name: Theo thBILL
oneLiner: thBILL is Theo Network's NAV-accreting wrapper of Standard Chartered Libeara's tokenized U.S. T-bill fund, mint/redeem gated to KYC-verified institutions.
collateral: Basket of institutional-grade tokenized U.S. Treasury bills; currently 100% tULTRA, a wrapped representation of Standard Chartered Libeara's ULTRA fund (Delta Wellington Ultra Short Treasury On-Chain Fund), managed by Wellington Management, custodied by Standard Chartered, fund administration by FundBridge Capital
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting token (not pegged to $1); price launched at ~$1.00 and appreciates as T-bill yield accrues; KYC-gated mint/redemption processed instantly in USDC, underlying collateral settled within T+4 business days; restricted to institutional and non-U.S. accredited investors

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Re-derived 2026-07-30 from Theo's live documentation and product page: thBILL is a NAV-accreting tokenized claim on a basket of institutional U.S. Treasury funds (tULTRA/ULTRA via Libeara-Wellington-Standard Chartered, plus FILQ via Fidelity International/Sygnum), minted and redeemed only by KYC-verified participants against USDC with no permissionless mint path and no claim on underlying assets for holders. The live stabilization and claim structure is a tokenized T-bill fund share, matching the tbill archetype already recorded; thBILL has no variantOf parent, so no archetypeOverride divergence applies.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, the UUPS proxy resolved to verified IToken implementation 0x325478a069b0dbbdfbee909fa3741f84259ba519. Its EMERGENCY_ROLE holder 0x7afb1d3308d22639f1ce698a2985cbf22f96d94a remained authorized to call pause(), and the implementation gates its shared _update path with whenNotPaused, so pausing blocks holder transfers as well as mint and redemption. The token was not paused at observation. A live two-day UUPS upgrade path provides an additional transfer-control surface.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment corrected at Ethereum block 25712112: thBILL is an ERC-1967 UUPS proxy using verified IToken implementation 0x325478a069b0dbbdfbee909fa3741f84259ba519. UUPS authorization is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-gated; timelock 0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02 is the sole current admin and has a 172800-second minimum delay. Theo documents a separate thBILL OFT contract for cross-chain movement.

LayerZero OFT V2 representation of Ethereum-native thBILL: the arbitrum contract is the documented thBILL OFT at the shared CREATE2 address 0xfdd22ce6d1f66bc0ec89b20bf16ccb6670f55a5a (endpoint() = the LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c with peers wired to Ethereum/Base/HyperEVM, read 2026-07-20). The OFT owner/delegate is the Theo 4-of-6 Admin Multisig 0x94877640dd9e6f1e3cb56bf7b5665b7152601295.

LayerZero OFT V2 representation of Ethereum-native thBILL: the base contract is the documented thBILL OFT at the shared CREATE2 address 0xfdd22ce6d1f66bc0ec89b20bf16ccb6670f55a5a (endpoint() = the LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c with peers wired to Ethereum/Base/HyperEVM, read 2026-07-20). The OFT owner/delegate is the Theo 4-of-6 Admin Multisig 0x94877640dd9e6f1e3cb56bf7b5665b7152601295.

LayerZero OFT V2 representation of Ethereum-native thBILL: the hyperevm contract is the documented thBILL OFT at the shared CREATE2 address 0xfdd22ce6d1f66bc0ec89b20bf16ccb6670f55a5a (endpoint() = the LayerZero V2 endpoint 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fE728c with peers wired to Ethereum/Base/HyperEVM, read 2026-07-20). The OFT owner/delegate is the Theo 4-of-6 Admin Multisig 0x94877640dd9e6f1e3cb56bf7b5665b7152601295.

LayerZero OFT V2 representation of Ethereum-native thBILL on Stable (evm chainId 988): the token sits at the same shared CREATE2 address 0xfdd22ce6d1f66bc0ec89b20bf16ccb6670f55a5a and returned symbol thBILL, 6 decimals, totalSupply 35,612,981.743756 (read 2026-07-29 at block 33586875 on rpc.stable.xyz and stable.drpc.org). endpoint() = the LayerZero V2 endpoint deployed on Stable, 0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b, with peers wired to the Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, and HyperEVM eids; oftVersion() reports the OFT V2 interface and sharedDecimals() = 6. owner() resolves to the Theo 4-of-6 Admin Multisig 0x94877640dd9e6f1e3cb56bf7b5665b7152601295, matching the other OFT legs. The Ethereum OFT Adapter 0xfdd22ce6d1f66bc0ec89b20bf16ccb6670f55a5a escrows this supply, so the Stable leg reallocates from the canonical Ethereum bucket rather than adding to it.

mintAuthority.summary: Canonical thBILL is a UUPS ERC-4626 multi-asset vault: public deposit and mint paths transfer supported collateral before minting shares, with no privileged raw-mint function. A two-day TimelockController holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UUPS authority; Theo's 4-of-6 Safe controls that timelock.

controls.label: thBILL ERC-4626 multi-asset wrapper
controls.capDescription: Public deposit and mint create thBILL shares only after the wrapper transfers the corresponding quantity of an accepted collateral asset from the caller; the wrapper exposes no uncollateralized or privileged raw-mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, asset() returned USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48 and depositAssetsList() returned supported asset 0x82b840b6edf77f90c92a70b99f0b5d50e7967330. The verified ERC-4626 multi-asset implementation transfers the requested collateral from the caller before internally minting shares; it exposes no privileged external raw-mint function.

controls.label: thBILL UUPS upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, this TimelockController was the sole live thBILL DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder and getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. Verified IToken source gates UUPS upgrades, emergency-role administration, deposit-asset/config changes, and other AccessControl administration through DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.

controls.label: Theo governance Safe (timelock proposer/executor/canceller)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, Safe state was 4-of-6, version 1.4.1, with the listed owners, no enabled modules, and zero guard. Timelock role checks confirmed this Safe holds PROPOSER_ROLE, EXECUTOR_ROLE, and CANCELLER_ROLE; it can therefore schedule and execute thBILL administration and UUPS upgrades after the two-day delay.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712112, direct reads and verified source established that canonical thBILL is a UUPS ERC-4626 multi-asset vault, correcting the prior issuer-backend and immutable-proxy claims. Its public deposit/mint flow transfers supported collateral before internal share minting and exposes no privileged raw-mint entry point. The current implementation is 0x325478a069b0dbbdfbee909fa3741f84259ba519; sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder timelock 0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02 has a 172800-second minimum delay, not zero. Safe 0x94877640dd9e6f1e3cb56bf7b5665b7152601295 holds proposer, executor, and canceller roles and was 4-of-6 with no modules or guard. Current share creation is collateral-transfer constrained, while governance can change deposit configuration or implementation after the delay, so the posture is partially bounded and economic cap semantics are raiseable.

reserves.issuerOrObligor: Theo Network / tULTRA (Standard Chartered Libeara tokenized U.S. Treasury bills)

reserveReview.rationale: Re-verified on 2026-08-08. The thBILL live reserve adapter exposes a single 100% slice labeled 'tULTRA tokenized U.S. Treasury bills'. This review classifies that compiled slice as a fund-share exposure to Theo's tULTRA instrument. Issuer materials also reference a FILQ allocation, but the live adapter does not itemize it separately; scoring follows the adapter's exact normalized name.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Theo thBILL single-asset live adapter label and issuer documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live adapter's single compiled slice is fully classified. Any allocation between tULTRA and FILQ within the issuer's underlying basket is not separately itemized by the adapter.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: tULTRA is a tokenized fund share, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: ULTRA is custodied by Standard Chartered per tULTRA docs; FILQ is accessed through Sygnum per Theo's FILQ announcement. Provider share percentages, segregation, rehypothecation, and thBILL holders' direct legal claim against underlying fund assets are not published in the reviewed sources. Prior 100% Standard Chartered share is removed because the dual-underlying structure makes a single-provider share unsupported.
